messages:
Maya Nguyen: Mini-series idea — wanna do an office watch night? Pick a short, punchy miniseries (4–8 eps). Drop recs and a one-line why and I’ll make a poll.
Omar Patel: Patriot — darkly funny spy show, tight 8 eps. Excellent lead and weirdly cozy. :100:
Liam Chen: The Night Of — gritty, tight, 8 eps. Superb courtroom stuff. Not great for eating pizza though. :grimacing:
Sasha Rowe: The Little Drummer Girl — slow burn, cinematic, perfect if you like art-house espionage. :clapper:
Ben (intern): The Jinx — true-crime doc, 6 eps. Obsessed with the final episode. :eyes:
Nora K: Signal (K-drama) — technically longer but the core arc is bingeable and brilliant mystery. I can handle subs if needed. :oncoming_police_car:
Maya Nguyen: Love these. Quick guidance: lighter = Patriot; heavy = The Night Of or Signal. Prefer 4–8 eps so people can actually show up after work.
polly-bot: Poll created: "Which mini-series for Office Watch Night?" Options: Patriot / The Night Of / The Jinx / The Little Drummer Girl / Other (reply to thread)
Omar Patel: Voted Patriot. Also throwing a wildcard: 'When They See Us' — 4 eps, emotionally heavy but incredible.
Liam Chen: Voted The Night Of. Can we avoid spoilers in thread pls.
Sasha Rowe: Voted The Little Drummer Girl. Also, accessibility ask: can we make sure captions are on? :ok_hand:
Ben (intern): Voted The Jinx. Also snacks? Pizza or charcuterie? :pizza:
Nora K: Voted Other (Signal). If we go non-English, I’ll QA the subtitle timing and link setup.
Maya Nguyen: Poll closes tomorrow 10:00am. Tentative plan: if Patriot wins -> Friday 7pm; if Night Of -> Saturday 8pm (so people recover).
Liam Chen: If we pick a heavy one, maybe quick 15–20 min discussion after ep1 so people can decompress.
Maya Nguyen: Sounds good — I’ll post final details and a streaming link after poll closes. Thanks for the recs! :sparkles:
